# Great partnerships begin with chemistry

## Chemtrade

Like elements acting in **partnership** to create the **chemical products** we sell, Chemtrade is
strengthened by the many people, groups and organizations we are fortunate to call partners.

We are driven by a clear Vision: **create value through responsible chemistry**. The three pillars
of Chemtrade’s Values – Safety, Excellence, and Partnership – shape everything we do, empowering our
people to serve customers with quality products and services across North America and around the
world.

Chemtrade is connections.

## Chemical Products

We operate in two strategic business segments, each featuring a lineup of high-quality industrial
chemical products.

## Product Applications

Chemtrade products are used in a wide range of industries and applications.

### Industries we serve include:

Water and Wastewater Treatment, Food, Beverage, Pulp & Paper, Oil & Gas, Industrial Processing,
Agriculture, and more.

## Environmental, Social & Governance

* [Responsible care img in Environmental, Social & Governance] *

### A promise to the planet

Chemtrade is committed to doing business in a responsible manner. Sustainability and safety are core
values woven into every aspect of our business from manufacturing to shipping, employee training,
and more. The commitment we make to offering a safe workplace and operating in a sustainable manner
extends through every level of our company.

Responsible Care®, the chemical industry’s voluntary, comprehensive initiative in safe, responsible,
and sustainable chemical manufacturing, is the heart of Chemtrade’s commitment to Environmental,
Social & Governance practices. It is a key element of our partnerships with the people who work
here, the customers and suppliers we do business with, and the communities we operate in.

Find out more about Chemtrade’s Commitment to [Environmental, Social & Governance practices and
Responsible Care®.][94]

# Your Source for Sodium Metal & Derivatives

Safe, efficient, sustainable. Flexible formats, compliant packaging, and quick turnaround for
chemistry, metallurgy, and heat transfer.

[ Learn More ][29]

Your reliable source

## Sodium Metal Products

At KaNaCell, our sole focus is sustainable sodium metal and derivatives—made from responsibly
sourced materials and powered by renewable energy. We continually improve the quality and
versatility of our products to support your evolving needs.



Our Canadian manufacturing facility in British Columbia helps simplify supply chains across North
America, enabling reliable, consistent delivery.



We constantly update equipment and procedures for the production, storage, and logistics of
dangerous goods. The result: high-purity, conveniently packaged products designed to make handling
and use as safe and efficient as possible.

#### Sustainable

#### Reliable

#### High-Purity

[ See Products ][30]

#### [Quick Preview][31]

## Products & Applications

Canadian-made sodium products for chemistry, metallurgy & heat transfer.

### Organic Chemistry

Convenient forms for trace water removal; ester, ether, and lignin reactions; formation of
alkoxides, enolates, nitriles, isocyanates, and organometallics; as well as fuel refining and
hydrogen-storage R&D.

[ Learn More ][32]

### Metallurgy

Sodium is a versatile universal reductant for most metals and for synthesis of nitride, carbide, and
boride ceramics. Additional uses include de-scaling stainless and specialty alloys and de-oxidizing
lead, steel, and bronze.

[ Learn More ][33]

### Heat Transfer Applications

Liquid sodium and NaK alloys deliver unmatched performance for high-temperature heat exchange.
Options include melting points from –12 °C to 97 °C and boiling points up to 882 °C.

[ Learn More ][34]

## Why KaNaCell

High-purity, conveniently packaged products

#### Reliable supply: Canadian manufacturing with stable, predictable delivery.

#### High purity: Tight process controls and batch documentation available.

#### Safety first: Hazardous-materials–compliant packaging and carriers.

#### Flexible formats: Multiple forms, pack sizes, and custom dispersions.

#### Responsive support: Technical guidance and quick quoting.

[ Get Started ][35]

## Packaging & Logistics

Nitrogen-blanketed cans, drums, and ISO tanks to match scale and application



Approved hazmat carriers and shipment documentation



Clear handling and storage guidance with every order (SDS provided)

### Sustainability

Our continuous-improvement program prioritizes energy efficiency, waste minimization, and renewable
power—aligning performance with environmental responsibility.

Safe, efficient, sustainable. Flexible formats, compliant packaging, and quick turnaround for
chemistry, metallurgy, and heat transfer.

[ Learn More ][29]

Your reliable source

## Sodium Metal Products

At KaNaCell, our sole focus is sustainable sodium metal and derivatives—made from responsibly
sourced materials and powered by renewable energy. We continually improve the quality and
versatility of our products to support your evolving needs.



Our Canadian manufacturing facility in British Columbia helps simplify supply chains across North
America, enabling reliable, consistent delivery.



We constantly update equipment and procedures for the production, storage, and logistics of
dangerous goods. The result: high-purity, conveniently packaged products designed to make handling
and use as safe and efficient as possible.

#### Sustainable

#### Reliable

#### High-Purity

#### [Quick Preview][31]

## Products & Applications

Canadian-made sodium products for chemistry, metallurgy & heat transfer.

### Organic Chemistry

Convenient forms for trace water removal; ester, ether, and lignin reactions; formation of
alkoxides, enolates, nitriles, isocyanates, and organometallics; as well as fuel refining and
hydrogen-storage R&D.

[ Learn More ][32]

### Metallurgy

Sodium is a versatile universal reductant for most metals and for synthesis of nitride, carbide, and
boride ceramics. Additional uses include de-scaling stainless and specialty alloys and de-oxidizing
lead, steel, and bronze.

[ Learn More ][33]

### Heat Transfer Applications

Liquid sodium and NaK alloys deliver unmatched performance for high-temperature heat exchange.
Options include melting points from –12 °C to 97 °C and boiling points up to 882 °C.

[ Learn More ][34]

## Why KaNaCell

High-purity, conveniently packaged products

#### Reliable supply: Canadian manufacturing with stable, predictable delivery.

#### High purity: Tight process controls and batch documentation available.

#### Safety first: Hazardous-materials–compliant packaging and carriers.

#### Flexible formats: Multiple forms, pack sizes, and custom dispersions.

#### Responsive support: Technical guidance and quick quoting.

[ Get Started ][35]

# Great partnerships begin with chemistry

## Chemtrade

Like elements acting in **partnership** to create the **chemical products** we sell, Chemtrade is
strengthened by the many people, groups and organizations we are fortunate to call partners.

We are driven by a clear Vision: **create value through responsible chemistry**. The three pillars
of Chemtrade’s Values – Safety, Excellence, and Partnership – shape everything we do, empowering our
people to serve customers with quality products and services across North America and around the
world.

Chemtrade is connections.

## Chemical Products

We operate in two strategic business segments, each featuring a lineup of high-quality industrial
chemical products.

Chemtrade products are used in a wide range of industries and applications.

### Industries we serve include:

## Environmental, Social & Governance

* [Responsible care img in Environmental, Social & Governance] *

### A promise to the planet

Chemtrade is committed to doing business in a responsible manner. Sustainability and safety are core
values woven into every aspect of our business from manufacturing to shipping, employee training,
and more. The commitment we make to offering a safe workplace and operating in a sustainable manner
extends through every level of our company.

Responsible Care®, the chemical industry’s voluntary, comprehensive initiative in safe, responsible,
and sustainable chemical manufacturing, is the heart of Chemtrade’s commitment to Environmental,
Social & Governance practices. It is a key element of our partnerships with the people who work
here, the customers and suppliers we do business with, and the communities we operate in.

Find out more about Chemtrade’s Commitment to [Environmental, Social & Governance practices and
Responsible Care®.][94]

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company

Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

**CMS INDUSTRIES** was formed with a foresight to manufacture and market all value added grades of
[Bentonite][134]. We are an **IS0 9001:2015** certified company. Our manufacturing units are
strategically located at Mandvi Taluka, close to the world class ports of Mundra and Kandla,
Gujarat. We are fully equipped to produce above **9000 Metric Tons of Bentonite powder in multiple
grades on a monthly basis.** We possess well-resourced facilities for the production of **Bentonite
Lumps, exceeding 26000 Metric Tons on a monthly basis**. We are involved in the direct and agency
[export][135] of all grades of Bentonite powder and lumps to a number of prominent companies across
the globe. Our prime locations for mines include Vandh, Pundi, Sherdi-Mandvi, Miyani,
Raidhanjar-Abdasa and the surrounding areas of Kachchh.

### Vision

Our vision is to be a leading Bentonite company; which provides premium quality Bentonite with
logistic advantage.

Our mission is to maximize the profitability of all our customers in their processes.

### Can Creative Engineers provide turnkey pilot plants or process units?

Yes. CEI is capable of doing the design, procurement, fabrication, testing, and startup of your
pilot plant and skid-mounted process units. Our staff of chemical-process engineers will prepare the
required mass-and-energy balance details and develop P&IDs so that CEI and the customer can agree on
what is to be built. The mechanical, automation, and electrical groups will prepare equipment
specifications, if necessary, and do detailed design. With the design agreed upon, our staff will
procure the equipment, assemble, and deliver the complete package. At CEI, we believe that the
success of any project depends heavily on the proper development of the project scope. We work with
our customers to provide the up-front detailed process engineering needed to succeed.

### Is CEI certified to any quality standards?

Yes, CEI is ISO 9001 certified, reflecting its commitment to quality management, continuous
improvement, and meeting international engineering standards.

#### Challenge
#### SEA Wire Inc. required a cost-effective solution for etching PTFE-coated wire of various
#### specifications and sizes. The project demanded a highly productive etching system capable of
#### handling four spools of wire simultaneously, including both unspooling and respooling
#### capabilities. The system needed to be straightforward enough for existing employees to operate
#### and had to be delivered within six months.
#### Solution
#### To meet SEA Wire's requirements, CEI developed a two-part solution:

#### ensuring a clean finish.

## Health is a process.

LMNT Co-Founder Robb Wolf shares the health journey that sparked a Salty Rebellion.

### I needed more salt. period.

I'd been on a low-carb, whole food diet for years, but something was holding me back. While working
with my coaches, we unlocked a powerful insight: I needed more salt. Period.
[Robb Wolf Wrestling]

### Popular products didn't cut it.

They're too high in sugar and woefully lacking in actual electrolytes — so we were making our own at
home, but that was messy and time-consuming. When I dialed in the formulation I immediately felt my
fitness, sleep, and brain functioning on new levels.
[Current Market Products]

### So we created LMNT.

Turns out, I needed to pay as much attention to my electrolytes as I did my food. And I’m not alone
— we’ve seen this play out across thousands of health journeys. My coaches helped me with this
critical missing link — I hope LMNT can be as meaningful for you.
[LMNT Team]

# Home Page

Marine Deck Maintenance Ship Hold Tank Cleaning Rigs & Oilfield Water Treatment

### Featured Marine Chemicals

#### Oil Spill Dispersant

Rapid-action dispersant that breaks down oil slicks into biodegradable microdroplets for safer,
faster marine and industrial cleanup.

#### Air Cooler Cleaning Chemical

Specially formulated cleaner that removes scale, dust, and microbial buildup to enhance air cooler
efficiency and airflow.

#### Vapor Treatment

High-performance volatile corrosion inhibitor that protects metal surfaces in closed steam and vapor
systems.

#### Rust Stain Remover

Quickly eliminates stubborn rust stains from decks, hulls, and painted surfaces without abrasion or
corrosion.

#### Descaling Liquid

Effectively removes lime and scale deposits from boilers and coolers.

#### Heavy Duty Degreaser

Heavy-duty marine degreaser engineered to dissolve tough grease, oil, and sludge from engine rooms,
bilges, and industrial surfaces.

### Featured Ship Hold & Tank Cleaning

#### Slip Barrier Coat

Polymer based product, forms a protective, non-stick barrier on cargo holds to prevent material
adhesion and ease post-discharge cleaning.

#### RX Tuff High Foam

High Foam, higher power - designed for hold cleaning and general degreasing.

#### Lime Remover HD

Innovative, concentrated liquid product specifically engineered to attack, penetrate and remove lime
deposit accumulations from cargo and storage tanks.

#### RXSOL PCS Hold Clean

Effectively removes, Coal Carbon, pet coke and mineral & lime deposits from cargo holds and tanks.

#### Alkaline Safety Liquid

Non-caustic alkaline cleaner formulated to remove vegetable oils, animal fats, hydrocarbons, lube
oils, and petcoke residues from cargo tanks.

#### Iron Ore Cargo Clean

Concentrated blend of RXSOL proprietory formulated various products, which is specifically designed
for the rapid removal of rust, while providing phosphatized ferrous metal surface.

### Featured Rigs & Oilfield Chemicals

#### RXSOL RIG WASH

Emulsifier with powerful penetrating agents, corrosion inhibitors and surfactants. Quickly removes
oil, grease, gimres - best for cleaning double bottom tanks

#### Corrosion Inhibitor for Oil Pipeline

A highly effective, film-forming corrosion control agent specifically designed for oil and gas
production and transmission systems operating under sour gas (H2S) and acid gas (CO2) conditions.

#### Crude Oil Defoamer

Defoamer designed to effectively control foam in crude oil processing and refinery operations.

#### H2S Scavenger

Wide range of Hydrogen Sulfide Scavenger to elimiate traces of H2S fouling.

#### Scale Inhibitor

Specially designed to inhibit the scale formation in polyamide-, celluloseacetate- and
polyethermembranes with anionically charged surface.

#### Flocculants

Specialized well oil flocculant that aggregates suspended oils and solids for improved separation
and wastewater clarity.

### Featured Water Treatment Chemicals

#### Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors

Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors for cooling towers - multi metal protection, as well as for boiler
treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

#### One Shot Treatment

Use one shot powder/liquid treatment for your cooling/boiler unit which contains - corrosion/scale
inhibitor, alkalinity booster, oxygen scavenger, etc.

proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional

work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate.

will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain.

GMP Metal Products is a 133 year old contract manufacturer of quality metal stampings, fabrications,
and assemblies.

[Learn MORE][9]

## Capabilities

With plants in St. Louis, Missouri and Humboldt, Tennessee, GMP Metal Products offers comprehensive
manufacturing capabilities including laser cutting, fabricating, stamping, forming, deep drawing,
welding and metal finishing. 

[[GMP Engineering]][10]

### Engineering

We are a customer-oriented company with a lean approach that provides innovative solutions for
product design and fabrication, leveraging our expertise in multiple stamping and fabricating
processes to reduce costs and improve quality while ensuring high engineering collaboration
throughout the production process.

[Learn More][11]
[[GMP Stamping Fabrication]][12]

### Stamping & Fabrication

GMP is a leading manufacturer of stamped and fabricated parts, equipped with 70 presses ranging up
to 1,500 tons, a talented engineering staff, a team of certified welders, and an ISO 9001:2008
certified quality system, serving heavyweight manufacturers in defense, agriculture, construction,
and specialty equipment industries.

[Learn More][13]

[[GMP Manufacturing]][14]

### Manufacturing

GMP’s competitive edge in the global market is attributed to consistent investments in manufacturing
capabilities, enabling production of heavy tonnage stamping, deep draw parts, large press bed sizes,
clutch/separator plates, press brakes, laser capabilities, welding, and ring seals.

[Learn More][15]
[[GMP Materials]][16]

### Materials

GMP’s collaborative relationships with sources in the US enable cost-effective procurement of
materials, and expedited orders are possible through their network of warehouse sources to meet even
the most demanding production schedules.

[Learn More][17]
[Our Capabilities][18]

## Your Industry, Our Expertise

At GMP Metal Products, we produce technically advanced engineered stampings and fabricated parts for
many industries and across a variety of market segments.

### [Defense][20]

Our primary products include hood supports, fenders, track wheels, foot rests, separator plates,
structural components, battery boxes, air and oil filter assemblies, formed body panels, engine
components, ballistic body panels, ordinance fuse liners, and ordinance shipping caps.

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business

## Sodium Metal Products

At KaNaCell, our sole focus is sustainable sodium metal and derivatives—made from responsibly
sourced materials and powered by renewable energy. We continually improve the quality and
versatility of our products to support your evolving needs.



Our Canadian manufacturing facility in British Columbia helps simplify supply chains across North
America, enabling reliable, consistent delivery.



We constantly update equipment and procedures for the production, storage, and logistics of
dangerous goods. The result: high-purity, conveniently packaged products designed to make handling
and use as safe and efficient as possible.

#### Reliable

## Products & Applications

Canadian-made sodium products for chemistry, metallurgy & heat transfer.

### Organic Chemistry

Convenient forms for trace water removal; ester, ether, and lignin reactions; formation of
alkoxides, enolates, nitriles, isocyanates, and organometallics; as well as fuel refining and
hydrogen-storage R&D.

[ Learn More ][32]

### Metallurgy

Sodium is a versatile universal reductant for most metals and for synthesis of nitride, carbide, and
boride ceramics. Additional uses include de-scaling stainless and specialty alloys and de-oxidizing
lead, steel, and bronze.

[ Learn More ][33]

### Heat Transfer Applications

Liquid sodium and NaK alloys deliver unmatched performance for high-temperature heat exchange.
Options include melting points from –12 °C to 97 °C and boiling points up to 882 °C.

[ Learn More ][34]

## Why KaNaCell

High-purity, conveniently packaged products

#### Reliable supply: Canadian manufacturing with stable, predictable delivery.

#### High purity: Tight process controls and batch documentation available.

#### Safety first: Hazardous-materials–compliant packaging and carriers.

#### Flexible formats: Multiple forms, pack sizes, and custom dispersions.

#### Responsive support: Technical guidance and quick quoting.

## Packaging & Logistics

Nitrogen-blanketed cans, drums, and ISO tanks to match scale and application



Approved hazmat carriers and shipment documentation



Clear handling and storage guidance with every order (SDS provided)

### Sustainability

Our continuous-improvement program prioritizes energy efficiency, waste minimization, and renewable
power—aligning performance with environmental responsibility.

## Products & Applications

Canadian-made sodium products for chemistry, metallurgy & heat transfer.

### Organic Chemistry

Convenient forms for trace water removal; ester, ether, and lignin reactions; formation of
alkoxides, enolates, nitriles, isocyanates, and organometallics; as well as fuel refining and
hydrogen-storage R&D.

[ Learn More ][32]

### Metallurgy

Sodium is a versatile universal reductant for most metals and for synthesis of nitride, carbide, and
boride ceramics. Additional uses include de-scaling stainless and specialty alloys and de-oxidizing
lead, steel, and bronze.

[ Learn More ][33]

### Heat Transfer Applications

Liquid sodium and NaK alloys deliver unmatched performance for high-temperature heat exchange.
Options include melting points from –12 °C to 97 °C and boiling points up to 882 °C.

## Mission

The mission of the NaCLO project is to promote the culture of hygiene and to participate in the
development, not only of health, of communities in low- and middle-income countries.

## **NaCLO Project**

**NaCLO is a key part of the ‘Hygiene and Disinfection’ project**, which aims to encourage and
support the dissemination of the culture of hygiene and the importance of disinfection in low and
middle-income countries.

It is an ambitious and wide-ranging project that contemplates health as an essential requirement for
the development of countries.

Medivac’s NaCLO project has hygiene as a priority: thus, in addition to initiatives aimed at
improving hygiene and health, NaCLO also embraces educational, micro-entrepreneurship and
international profit-non-profit cooperation initiatives.

## Mission

The mission of the NaCLO project is to promote the culture of hygiene and to participate in the
development, not only of health, of communities in low- and middle-income countries.

## **NaCLO Project**

**NaCLO is a key part of the ‘Hygiene and Disinfection’ project**, which aims to encourage and
support the dissemination of the culture of hygiene and the importance of disinfection in low and
middle-income countries.

It is an ambitious and wide-ranging project that contemplates health as an essential requirement for
the development of countries.

Medivac’s NaCLO project has hygiene as a priority: thus, in addition to initiatives aimed at
improving hygiene and health, NaCLO also embraces educational, micro-entrepreneurship and
international profit-non-profit cooperation initiatives.

## The Facts

Several examples of an earlier version of NaCLO, made with the aim of gaining experience in the
field, have been used in various African countries, such as [**Senegal, Democratic Republic of
the Congo, Mali, Guinea-Bissau, Ethiopia, Eritrea etc.,**][27] with positive effects, for example,
on the sanitation of rural clinics. The electrolytic sodium hypochlorite produced on site has also
been used in the past years to fight the Ebola Virus, creating a sort of sanitary cordon around the
most affected areas to contain the reproduction of the virus.


Infections caused by the unavailability of drinking water or the presence of bacteria in houses,
public places and hospitals are the main reasons of serious diseases, especially in underdeveloped
areas where the risk of exposure for the population is higher. To help tackle the issue, NaCLO
offers a mini plant called NaCLO 30L, an equipment that produces, by electrolysis, an aqueous
disinfectant solution on sodium hypochlorite-based, one of the world’s most widely used and
effective disinfectants.

## 12V batteries, but better

Ohmmu Energy is a leading innovator in 12V battery technology specializing in clean, reliable and
high-performance smart lithium and sodium batteries for electric vehicles, recreational vehicles,
marine, overland, solar, on-board electronics and off-grid systems.

With a commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability, we offer cutting-edge energy solutions
designed to outperform both traditional lead-acid batteries and their fellow competitors in the same
spaces.
**
**Let’s power your adventures.

[ Our Story ][36]

## Two chemistries. One mission. Better than lead-acid.

For over a decade, Ohmmu has pushed the limits of 12V battery technology — starting with lithium and
never looking back. When sodium cell technology matured to the point where it could offer something
genuinely different — not just cheaper, but better in specific real-world conditions — we knew it
earned a place in our lineup.

Both chemistries leave traditional lead-acid in the dust. But they do it differently. Here's how to
choose the one that's right for your vehicle and your life.

and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

A unit is a measurement of a quantity that is defined or adopted by tradition or law. Other
quantities can be expressed as a multiple of the unit.

In human history, various unit systems were developed and used in different regions and cultures.
Currently, the global standard of measurement is the International System of Units (SI), which is a
modern form of the metric system. Although SI is intended for global use, it has not been fully
adopted, and some other systems of measurement are still used in parts of the world.

The intent of this site is to provide a convenient means to convert between the various units of
measurement within different systems, as well as to provide a basic understanding of the systems
currently in use, and how they interact. Refer to the [Common Unit Systems][120] page for further
information.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's

benzene and many more contaminants in soils, groundwater, and surface water environments.

**CMS INDUSTRIES** was formed with a foresight to manufacture and market all value added grades of
[Bentonite][134]. We are an **IS0 9001:2015** certified company. Our manufacturing units are
strategically located at Mandvi Taluka, close to the world class ports of Mundra and Kandla,
Gujarat. We are fully equipped to produce above **9000 Metric Tons of Bentonite powder in multiple
grades on a monthly basis.** We possess well-resourced facilities for the production of **Bentonite
Lumps, exceeding 26000 Metric Tons on a monthly basis**. We are involved in the direct and agency
[export][135] of all grades of Bentonite powder and lumps to a number of prominent companies across
the globe. Our prime locations for mines include Vandh, Pundi, Sherdi-Mandvi, Miyani,
Raidhanjar-Abdasa and the surrounding areas of Kachchh.

Our vision is to be a leading Bentonite company; which provides premium quality Bentonite with
logistic advantage.

Our mission is to maximize the profitability of all our customers in their processes.

### Can Creative Engineers provide turnkey pilot plants or process units?

Yes. CEI is capable of doing the design, procurement, fabrication, testing, and startup of your
pilot plant and skid-mounted process units. Our staff of chemical-process engineers will prepare the
required mass-and-energy balance details and develop P&IDs so that CEI and the customer can agree on
what is to be built. The mechanical, automation, and electrical groups will prepare equipment
specifications, if necessary, and do detailed design. With the design agreed upon, our staff will
procure the equipment, assemble, and deliver the complete package. At CEI, we believe that the
success of any project depends heavily on the proper development of the project scope. We work with
our customers to provide the up-front detailed process engineering needed to succeed.

improvement, and meeting international engineering standards.

## Health is a process.

LMNT Co-Founder Robb Wolf shares the health journey that sparked a Salty Rebellion.

### I needed more salt. period.

I'd been on a low-carb, whole food diet for years, but something was holding me back. While working
with my coaches, we unlocked a powerful insight: I needed more salt. Period.
[Robb Wolf Wrestling]

### Popular products didn't cut it.

They're too high in sugar and woefully lacking in actual electrolytes — so we were making our own at
home, but that was messy and time-consuming. When I dialed in the formulation I immediately felt my
fitness, sleep, and brain functioning on new levels.
[Current Market Products]

### So we created LMNT.

Turns out, I needed to pay as much attention to my electrolytes as I did my food. And I’m not alone
— we’ve seen this play out across thousands of health journeys. My coaches helped me with this
critical missing link — I hope LMNT can be as meaningful for you.

and wastewater clarity.

treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story

# Stamping Technology for the Global Market

GMP Metal Products is a 133 year old contract manufacturer of quality metal stampings, fabrications,
and assemblies.

[Learn MORE][9]

## Capabilities

With plants in St. Louis, Missouri and Humboldt, Tennessee, GMP Metal Products offers comprehensive
manufacturing capabilities including laser cutting, fabricating, stamping, forming, deep drawing,
welding and metal finishing. 

[[GMP Engineering]][10]

### Engineering

We are a customer-oriented company with a lean approach that provides innovative solutions for
product design and fabrication, leveraging our expertise in multiple stamping and fabricating
processes to reduce costs and improve quality while ensuring high engineering collaboration
throughout the production process.

[Learn More][11]
[[GMP Stamping Fabrication]][12]

### Stamping & Fabrication

GMP is a leading manufacturer of stamped and fabricated parts, equipped with 70 presses ranging up
to 1,500 tons, a talented engineering staff, a team of certified welders, and an ISO 9001:2008
certified quality system, serving heavyweight manufacturers in defense, agriculture, construction,
and specialty equipment industries.

[Learn More][13]

[[GMP Manufacturing]][14]

### Manufacturing

GMP’s competitive edge in the global market is attributed to consistent investments in manufacturing
capabilities, enabling production of heavy tonnage stamping, deep draw parts, large press bed sizes,
clutch/separator plates, press brakes, laser capabilities, welding, and ring seals.

[Learn More][15]
[[GMP Materials]][16]

### Materials

GMP’s collaborative relationships with sources in the US enable cost-effective procurement of
materials, and expedited orders are possible through their network of warehouse sources to meet even
the most demanding production schedules.

[Learn More][17]
[Our Capabilities][18]

## Your Industry, Our Expertise

At GMP Metal Products, we produce technically advanced engineered stampings and fabricated parts for
many industries and across a variety of market segments. 

### [Agriculture][19]

### [Defense][20]

### [Off-Highway][21]

## Products

Our primary products include hood supports, fenders, track wheels, foot rests, separator plates,
structural components, battery boxes, air and oil filter assemblies, formed body panels, engine
components, ballistic body panels, ordinance fuse liners, and ordinance shipping caps.

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a
Partner scores the fit and brokers the introduction.

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

## KDC CHEMICAL

KDC CHEMICAL chuyên phân phối hóa chất công nghiệp, hóa chất phòng thí nghiệm và nguyên liệu phục vụ
sản xuất cho nhiều lĩnh vực như điện tử, gốm sứ, thủy tinh, xử lý nước, cao su, nhựa, pin lithium và
vật liệu mới.

Chúng tôi không ngừng mở rộng nguồn cung quốc tế, kiểm soát chất lượng nghiêm ngặt và đồng hành cùng
khách hàng trong quá trình nghiên cứu, sản xuất và phát triển sản phẩm.

### Nghiên cứu & Giải pháp

Đội ngũ kỹ thuật hỗ trợ lựa chọn sản phẩm phù hợp với từng quy trình sản xuất.
[Chất lượng & An toàn]

### Chất lượng & An toàn

Sản phẩm có đầy đủ COA, MSDS và nguồn gốc xuất xứ rõ ràng.
[Phát triển & Hợp tác]

### Phát triển & Hợp tác

Xây dựng mối quan hệ lâu dài với khách hàng và đối tác trong nước và quốc tế.

quả sản xuất.

The mission of the NaCLO project is to promote the culture of hygiene and to participate in the
development, not only of health, of communities in low- and middle-income countries.

## **NaCLO Project**

**NaCLO is a key part of the ‘Hygiene and Disinfection’ project**, which aims to encourage and
support the dissemination of the culture of hygiene and the importance of disinfection in low and
middle-income countries.

It is an ambitious and wide-ranging project that contemplates health as an essential requirement for
the development of countries.

Medivac’s NaCLO project has hygiene as a priority: thus, in addition to initiatives aimed at
improving hygiene and health, NaCLO also embraces educational, micro-entrepreneurship and
international profit-non-profit cooperation initiatives.

[meet our team][26]

> ### How did the idea for NaCLO come about?

The project is the result of long journeys in rural Africa by our friend Franco Ladavas, a former
member of the Board of Directors of Industrie De Nora SpA, a world leader in the construction of
electrochemical plants. Thanks also to his experience as a chemist, Ladavas realized how to tackle
the serious lack of hygiene in low- and middle-income countries.

read below

A shortage made even more dramatic by largely inadequate health systems: a combination that
constitutes an enormous obstacle to the overall development of those countries. Ladavas thus became
aware that he could contribute to improving the sanitary situation in Africa and founded the
Association “Amici di Marco ETS”, in memory of his son Marco who died prematurely. Immediately
afterwards, he involved his friend Carlo Valesi and MEDIVAC Srl in the conception and construction
of a small electro-chlorinator suitable for producing electrolytic sodium hypochlorite on site in a
simple and low-cost way. Ladavas and Valesi have only one goal: to equip health centers and
hospitals with a system for the local and on-demand production of disinfectant.

So, in 2009, they installed one of the first devices to produce electrolytic sodium hypochlorite in
the hospital of Uvira (Democratic Republic of Congo), thanks to which they could also train local
technicians in the management of the equipment, in the production and use of the disinfectant in its
different dilutions. Subsequently, other devices were installed in several African countries and in
Bangladesh. During the years 2019-2021, MEDIVAC Srl then undertook to redesign and rationalize the
production system to facilitate its transport, installation, and production start-up, also equipping
it with photovoltaic panels (optional) to make it usable anywhere.

** Thus, the NaCLO 30 mini-plant and the NaCLO Solar kit were born.**

## The Facts

Several examples of an earlier version of NaCLO, made with the aim of gaining experience in the
field, have been used in various African countries, such as [**Senegal, Democratic Republic of
the Congo, Mali, Guinea-Bissau, Ethiopia, Eritrea etc.,**][27] with positive effects, for example,
on the sanitation of rural clinics. The electrolytic sodium hypochlorite produced on site has also
been used in the past years to fight the Ebola Virus, creating a sort of sanitary cordon around the
most affected areas to contain the reproduction of the virus.


Infections caused by the unavailability of drinking water or the presence of bacteria in houses,
public places and hospitals are the main reasons of serious diseases, especially in underdeveloped
areas where the risk of exposure for the population is higher. To help tackle the issue, NaCLO
offers a mini plant called NaCLO 30L, an equipment that produces, by electrolysis, an aqueous
disinfectant solution on sodium hypochlorite-based, one of the world’s most widely used and
effective disinfectants.

objectives stated in the corporate mission and vision.

[**“NaCLO for Africa – Hygiene as an essential health requisite for the development in low- and
middle income countries” is the end point of the MEDIVAC’s CSR program.**][29]

## 12V batteries, but better

Ohmmu Energy is a leading innovator in 12V battery technology specializing in clean, reliable and
high-performance smart lithium and sodium batteries for electric vehicles, recreational vehicles,
marine, overland, solar, on-board electronics and off-grid systems.

With a commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability, we offer cutting-edge energy solutions
designed to outperform both traditional lead-acid batteries and their fellow competitors in the same
spaces.
**
**Let’s power your adventures.

[ Our Story ][36]

## Two chemistries. One mission. Better than lead-acid.

For over a decade, Ohmmu has pushed the limits of 12V battery technology — starting with lithium and
never looking back. When sodium cell technology matured to the point where it could offer something
genuinely different — not just cheaper, but better in specific real-world conditions — we knew it
earned a place in our lineup.

Both chemistries leave traditional lead-acid in the dust. But they do it differently. Here's how to
choose the one that's right for your vehicle and your life.

stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

forward-looking decisions.

A unit is a measurement of a quantity that is defined or adopted by tradition or law. Other
quantities can be expressed as a multiple of the unit.

In human history, various unit systems were developed and used in different regions and cultures.
Currently, the global standard of measurement is the International System of Units (SI), which is a
modern form of the metric system. Although SI is intended for global use, it has not been fully
adopted, and some other systems of measurement are still used in parts of the world.

The intent of this site is to provide a convenient means to convert between the various units of
measurement within different systems, as well as to provide a basic understanding of the systems
currently in use, and how they interact. Refer to the [Common Unit Systems][120] page for further
information.
